market.settlementRule: If the BTC price at time of settlement is above 100000 at 20261231-2100, Yes tokens pay out $1 each. Otherwise, No tokens pay out $1 each. Settlement is according to the 300-second TWAP of mark price before settlement time.

candidates.reason: Spot/perp exposure can reduce underlying price beta, but not event settlement risk.

leg.rationale: BTC exposure can be partially hedged with Hyperliquid perp.
limitations: The hedge will not perfectly match the YES/NO payout.
Funding, timing, and settlement price can move differently.
Near settlement, the outcome price can move much faster than the hedge.

note: A Hyperliquid perp or spot hedge offsets the underlying price move only; the outcome token still settles on its own rule and can go to zero.
